value.rationale: This determines a sharp natural graph-semigroup transport invariant simultaneously for infinitely many unweighted complete multipartite graphs, discovers its largest-part-only universality despite part-sensitive spectra, and gives the necessary-and-sufficient threshold and unique maximal transient expansion. It is a substantive exact finite-graph family classification, not just a bound or routine numeric table.
